blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY – In a move prioritizing public welfare and climate readiness over holiday festivities, the local government units of Basilan and Cagayan de Oro City have canceled their annual year-end holiday parties to redirect resources for preparedness and mitigation measures against the potential severe impacts of the Super El Niño. In Basilan, Gov. Mujiv Hataman issued Executive Order No. 52, Series of 2026, directing all provincial government officials and employees to refrain from organizing, sponsoring, or holding year-end celebrations using public funds. “The cancelation of the traditional annual year-end gathering of provincial government officials and employees is deemed a necessary […]...
